document.Executive Summary: ScaleUP is a technology startup serving SMEs and growth-stage companies seeking AI implementation, automation, and data strategy support. The brand should communicate smart, clear, innovative qualities with a consistent identity across digital and print touchpoints.

Brand Strategy.purpose: Why the brand exists: Deliver practical AI projects and consulting that help companies scale operations and decision quality.
Brand Strategy.vision: Desired future state: Become the trusted AI consulting partner for growth-stage companies in North Africa and Europe.
Brand Strategy.mission: Deliver practical AI projects and consulting that help companies scale operations and decision quality.

Brand Identity.logo_guidelines: Use the logo consistently on light and dark backgrounds. Maintain clear space, avoid distortion, and keep a monochrome version available for restricted print use.
typography: Preference note: clean modern sans-serif for headings and readable sans-serif for body
Brand Identity.logo_generation_note: Logo concepts generated in 'crisp_charter_generator' mode using the Kaggle logo dataset as training/reference source. Use these as design directions and finalize with manual designer refinement.

Brand Application.website: Use the brand palette, type hierarchy, and logo clear space rules on the homepage and product pages.
Brand Application.social_media: Keep captions, cover images, and story assets consistent with the selected tone and color system.
Brand Application.marketing_materials: Apply the same visual identity to brochures, pitch decks, ads, and email headers.
Brand Application.presentation: Use branded title slides, section dividers, and icon styling.

document.Target Audience: SMEs and growth-stage companies seeking AI implementation, automation, and data strategy support.
document.Visual Identity Guidelines: Imagery should be professional, minimalist, consultancy-oriented. The visual system should feel professional, trustworthy, innovative and support the technology context.
document.Tone of Voice: The brand should sound professional. Keep copy aligned with the audience and the startup stage.
document.Brand Positioning: Position the brand as modern, reliable, and scalable.
Key Messaging: What we do: Deliver practical AI projects and consulting that help companies scale operations and decision quality.
Who we serve: SMEs and growth-stage companies seeking AI implementation, automation, and data strategy support.
Why we matter: Become the trusted AI consulting partner for growth-stage companies in North Africa and Europe.
Usage Guidelines: Always use the approved logo variants.
Use the approved palette across digital and print.
Keep spacing, typography, and tone consistent.
Adapt tone slightly by channel, but keep the same brand personality.
Review generated logo concepts with a designer before final lockup approval.
